findings.causal_account: Java applies UHidden.HIDDEN to a hidden SvekEdge at the final paint layer. LimitFinder.apply accepts UHidden and continues recording DotPath and UText bounds, so hidden edge labels/routes can affect the final SVG envelope even though the emitted SVG group/path/text is suppressed. Rust retains the hidden connection for AST, layout, Opale incidence, and UID order, but its no-oracle body frame skips hidden edges from paint-envelope modeling. This violates the claimed invariant that only the final SVG paint is suppressed.
